descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Who we are: 
 Open-minded intellectuals who embrace emerging technologies on our mission to create innovative Software Engineering Solutions that will impact millions of users around the world.
 We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer to join a strategic software engineering team responsible for developing, maintaining, and modernizing a business-critical platform within the insurance industry.
 In this role, you will collaborate with Business Analysts, Solution Architects, and fellow Developers to deliver high-quality software solutions that support core business processes. You will participate in the full software development lifecycle, from technical analysis and solution design to implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.
 The ideal candidate combines strong backend and frontend development expertise with a proactive mindset, excellent problem-solving skills, and a passion for building scalable, maintainable, and high-performing applications.
 Key Responsibilities 
Manage the end-to-end software development lifecycle for assigned projects and enhancements.
Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
Perform technical analysis and contribute to solution design activities.
Design, develop, test, and maintain both backend and frontend application components.
Write clean, efficient, maintainable, and well-documented code following industry best practices.
Ensure software quality through unit testing, functional testing, and code reviews.
Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues, providing third-level support when required.
Contribute to system optimization, modernization initiatives, and process automation opportunities.
Mentor and support less experienced developers on technical topics.
Participate in architectural discussions and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
Ensure compliance with security, quality, and operational standards.
 Required Skills & Experience 
Minimum 5 years of professional experience in software development using C# and .NET technologies.
Strong experience with SQL and relational databases.
Proven experience developing modern web applications using JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and JSON.
Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles and SOLID design principles.
Hands-on experience with React in enterprise environments.
Experience building and consuming REST APIs.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work effectively in Agile development environments.
Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams.
Professional working proficiency in English.
 Nice to Have 
Experience with Azure DevOps Server or Azure DevOps Services.
Knowledge of Angular or Vue.js.
Experience in the insurance, financial services, or highly regulated industries.
Exposure to CI/CD practices and software delivery automation.
Understanding of enterprise application architecture and software design patterns.
 What We Are Looking For 
A senior engineer capable of taking ownership of complex technical challenges.
A collaborative professional who enjoys working closely with both technical and business stakeholders.
Someone who can combine hands-on development with technical leadership and mentoring responsibilities.
A proactive mindset focused on continuous improvement, innovation, and software quality.
An individual interested in contributing to the modernization and long-term evolution of a strategic enterprise platform.
 What's in it for you: 
Extended compensation and benefits package
Continuous learning opportunities to enhance your professional and soft skills
A great working environment with people who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do and understand the importance of team spirit
 #LI-DG1
 We really welcome open-minded and committed people: 
Eager to take on new challenges and learn new things;
Who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do;
Who enjoy sharing knowledge and understand the importance of team spirit.
 Note* 
 SII Romania is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to promoting diversity, equality and inclusion within our workforce and working environment. For this purpose, we encourage all qualified candidates regardless of gender, age, sexual orientation, race ethnicity, beliefs, marital status, disability or other characteristics to send us their applications. 
 ***Only eligible candidates will be contacted to move forward in the recruitment process.
